title: Arabian Nights
text:
The Sheesha Arabian Night, popularly known as Arabian Nights is a restaurant located just outside the Puri Gate of the campus. They mostly serve pizza and non vegetarian food and provide free home delivery. They are closed on Friday.

 History 

 Facilities and cuisines 
The restaurant is popular for its Shwarma, Garlic Bread, and other Chicken items.
